title: Shan Folk Lore Stories from the Hill and Water Country
title_english: Shan Folk Lore Stories from the Hill and Water Country
title_as: শ্বান লোককথা: পাহাৰ আৰু নদীৰ দেশৰ সাধু (১৯০২)
title_tai: ꩫိထၢၼ် တႆး မိူင်း လွႆ လႄႈ ၼမ်ႉ
author: Dr. William C. Griggs, M.D.
provenance: Philadelphia: American Baptist Publication Society / ABM Press Rangoon / Internet Archive (shanfolklorestor32375gut)
description: Foundational collection of authentic oral folklore stories collected among the Shan and Tai peoples of the Shan States and Upper Irrawaddy, recorded by medical missionary Dr. W. C. Griggs and dedicated to Dr. J. N. Cushing. Contains folk wisdom, trickster tales (the Hare and the Tiger), cosmogonic narratives, and royal legends reflecting shared Southwestern Tai moral cosmology and lexical structures parallel to Tai Khamyang.

sentences.text_roman: pauwk neung nai meung laai-khaa mii mae-ying kaw neung taang-lii mii nam .
sentences.romanization: pauwk neung nai meung laai-khaa mii mae-ying kaw neung taang-lii mii nam .
sentences.assamese_script: পৌক নিং নাই মৌং লাইখা মি মে-য়িং কৌ নিং তাং-লি মি নাম।
sentences.surface_assamese: পৌক নিং নাই মৌং লাইখা মি মে-য়িং কৌ নিং তাং-লি মি নাম।
sentences.free_translation_en: Once upon a time in the State of Lai Hka, there lived a pious woman of great virtue.
sentences.free_translation_as: এসময়ত লাইখা ৰাজ্যত এগৰাকী পৰম ধাৰ্মিক আৰু গুণৱতী মহিলা আছিল।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.location: Lai Hka, Shan States / Upper Burma
sentences.notes: Opening formula of Shan/Khamyang folktales ('pauwk neung' = once upon a time; 'meung' = country/principality).

sentences.text_roman: kuu pii pawy ten laaeng man naang yawn suu tii phraa .
sentences.romanization: kuu pii pawy ten laaeng man naang yawn suu tii phraa .
sentences.assamese_script: কু পি পয় তেন লেং মান নাং য়ন চু তি ফ্ৰা।

sentences.free_translation_en: Every year at the Festival of Lights, the noble lady offered prayers and sought blessings before the Buddha.
sentences.free_translation_as: প্ৰতি বছৰে দেৱালী/বতি জ্বলোৱা উৎসৱত সেই মহিলাই বুদ্ধৰ চৰণত প্ৰাৰ্থনা কৰি বৰদান মাগিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.notes: 'pawy ten laaeng' denotes the Southwestern Tai Buddhist festival of floating lights and illumination.

sentences.assamese_script: নাং খাম-উং পেন লুক-য়িং চাউ-ফা মি আ-থা-ৰে তে-তে।

sentences.free_translation_en: Princess Nang Kam Ung was the daughter of the Sawbwa and possessed incomparable celestial grace.
sentences.free_translation_as: ৰাজকুমাৰী নাং খাম উং আছিল চাওফাৰ কন্যা আৰু তেওঁ অপৰূপ সৌন্দৰ্যৰে মণ্ডিত আছিল।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.notes: Reflects the famous folktale 'The Story of the Princess Nang Kam Ung' in Griggs's collection.

sentences.text_roman: paan nan paa-taay lae seuw yen pen uwy-kaw kan .
sentences.romanization: paan nan paa-taay lae seuw yen pen uwy-kaw kan .
sentences.assamese_script: পান নান পা-তাই লে সৌ য়েন পেন উই-কৌ কান।

sentences.free_translation_en: In that ancient time, the cunning hare and the ferocious tiger became traveling companions.
sentences.free_translation_as: সেই পুৰণি কালত টেঙৰ শহা আৰু বাঘটো পৰস্পৰ বন্ধু হৈ পৰিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.notes: Opening of 'How the Hare Deceived the Tiger'; 'paa-taay' is the Shan/Khamyang word for hare/rabbit.

sentences.text_roman: paa-taay laen seuw waa phun phaa te tok maa neuw ho .
sentences.romanization: paa-taay laen seuw waa phun phaa te tok maa neuw ho .
sentences.assamese_script: পা-তাই লেন সৌ ৱা ফুন ফা তে তুক মা নৌ হ।
sentences.surface_assamese: পা-তাই লেন সৌ ৱা ফুন ফা তে তুক মা নৌ হ।
sentences.free_translation_en: The clever hare tricked the tiger by warning that rocks and thunderbolts were about to fall from the sky upon their heads.
sentences.free_translation_as: টেঙৰ শহই বাঘক প্ৰতাৰণা কৰি ক’লে যে আকাশৰ পৰা শিলেৰে শিলাবৃষ্টি মূৰৰ ওপৰত সৰি পৰিব।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.notes: Classic Southwestern Tai trickster motif illustrating the victory of intellect ('panya') over brute force.

sentences.romanization: taw tow neung luk nai nawng nam luy maa tii phang .

sentences.free_translation_en: A wise tortoise emerged from the deep mountain lake and swam towards the riverbank.
sentences.free_translation_as: এটা জ্ঞানৱান কাছ গভীৰ হ্ৰদৰ পানীৰ পৰা ওলাই নদীৰ পাৰলৈ সাঁতুৰি আহিল।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.notes: From 'The Story of the Tortoise'; 'taw tow neung' uses the animal classifier 'tow'.

sentences.lik_tai: ၵူၼ်း မၢၵ်ႈမီ တင်း ၵူၼ်း ယၢၵ်ႈ ယူႇ ၸွမ်း ၵၼ် ၼႂ်း ဝၢၼ်ႈ ။

sentences.text_roman: kun maak-mii tang kun yaak yuu chwam kan nai waan .
sentences.romanization: kun maak-mii tang kun yaak yuu chwam kan nai waan .
sentences.assamese_script: কুন মাক-মি তাং কুন য়াক য়ু চ্বম কান নাই ৱান।

sentences.free_translation_en: Rich merchants and poor farmers lived together side by side within the village.
sentences.free_translation_as: গাঁৱখনত ধনী মহাজন আৰু দুখীয়া কৃষকসকলে একেলগে বসবাস কৰিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.notes: 'kun maak-mii' (rich person) and 'kun yaak' (poor person) form standard antonymous pairs in Tai.

sentences.assamese_script: চাউ হ-খাম মৌং পু-কাম ঞপ লাই কুন লাক খৌ।

sentences.free_translation_en: The King of the Golden Palace of Pagan apprehended the thief through subtle wisdom.
sentences.free_translation_as: পাগানৰ স্বৰ্ণ-প্ৰাসাদৰ ৰজাই চতুৰ বুদ্ধিৰে চোৰটোক ধৰা পেলালে।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.notes: Reflects the story 'How the King of Pagan Caught the Thief'; 'chaaw haw-kham' is the monarch of the golden palace.

sentences.text_roman: nok chawk awn mii luk awn lii aam nai haang .
sentences.romanization: nok chawk awn mii luk awn lii aam nai haang .
sentences.assamese_script: নুক চক অন মি লুক অন লি আম নাই হাং।
sentences.surface_assamese: নুক চক অন মি লুক অন লি আম নাই হাং।
sentences.free_translation_en: The little sparrow nurtured her wondrous brood of chicks within her safe nest.
sentences.free_translation_as: সৰু চৰাইটোক নিজৰ বাহত আচৰিত পোৱালিবোৰৰ যত্ন লৈছিল।
sentences.speaker: Folklore Narrator / Dr. W. C. Griggs
sentences.notes: From 'The Sparrow's Wonderful Brood'; 'nok chawk' = sparrow.

sentences.romanization: luk laan tay te-lai tawng kwaam sang mun-chaaw .

sentences.free_translation_en: The children and descendants of the Tai must remember the righteous teachings and oral wisdom of their elders.
sentences.free_translation_as: টাইসকলৰ উত্তৰ-পুৰুষসকলে বয়োবৃদ্ধ আৰু গুৰুসকলৰ জ্ঞানগর্ভ উপদেশ সদায় মনত ৰখা উচিত।

sentences.notes: Didactic closing formula emphasizing intergenerational cultural transmission.
